assessment_objectives.objective: a capability to govern logical Identification and Access Management (IAM) controls is implemented.
the Identification and Access Management (IAM) program is organization-wide.
Identification and Access Management (IAM) operations are conducted according to documented policies, standards, procedures and/or other organizational directives.
the resources (e.g., people, processes, technologies, data and/or facilities) required to support Identification and Access Management (IAM) operations are allocated.
responsibility and authority for the performance of Identification and Access Management (IAM)-related activities are assigned to designated personnel.
personnel performing Identification and Access Management (IAM)-related activities have the skills and knowledge needed to perform their assigned duties.
